name: Bolaji Ladokun
headline: Turning cyber risk into business decisions.
intro: I'm a cybersecurity leader with more than ten years across aerospace, telecoms, online gaming, IT services and enterprise AI. I help organisations treat security as a strategic enabler: aligned with business goals, understood by the board, and built to support growth rather than slow it down.

focus.title: Security & IT strategy
focus.text: Roadmaps that start from business objectives, so security investment follows the risks that matter most to growth.

focus.title: Risk, governance & regulation
focus.text: Risk management and governance that turn regulatory readiness into an advantage instead of a scramble before the audit.

focus.title: Resilience & security operations
focus.text: Security architecture, detection and business continuity designed around how the organisation actually runs.

focus.title: Secure AI adoption
focus.text: Letting the business move quickly with AI, with the guardrails, accountability and oversight that make it safe.
